Staff accounts

Add each staff member using the email address they use to sign in. Managers can edit products and costs; supervisors can review history and operations; staff can complete stocktakes and movements.

Change log

Changes to stock item details, suppliers and staff accounts are recorded automatically and can’t be edited or deleted. Counts typed straight into a quantity box and physical count corrections are recorded too; deliveries, wastage, transfers and stocktakes are in History. Times are Hobart time. Tap an entry to see exactly what changed.
